g.text: This map highlights key leverage points for interventions aimed at breaking
the negative feedback loop and promoting the well-being of social media
users. Proposed strategies include regulatory and technological measures
alongside efforts to raise awareness. These encompass stricter content
regulations, algorithm adjustments, tools for self-regulation, and fostering
intentional engagement to support healthier habits. Additionally, emphasizing
trusted learning channels and ensuring platform accountability for content
moderation contributes to a safer and more constructive online environment.
